label: Bund survey

license.author: NemoWorld project contributors
license.source: Original NemoWorld authored content: the place manifests in src/content-manifest.js, validated against the venue machinery in world.js
license.note: Authored for this project; no third-party asset was copied. A place declares a space and the machinery it reuses and draws no new geometry. The repository carries no LICENSE file, so redistribution terms are unstated. See content/THIRD_PARTY.md.

rules.clock: tick indices counted from the world boot; no wall-clock time, no date and no generator is read, so two runs of the same world produce the same schedule
rules.implements: the living-world resident loop (src/living-world.js) and the venue machinery the place names; this definition records the schedule the loop is expected to keep and is not yet read by it

notes: A guide walks the three bunds in order and stops at the pond margin. It reads no evidence and adopts nothing.
